origins: FrontierOR: Benchmarking LLMs on Large-Scale Optimization (arXiv:2605.25246), a benchmark comparing one-shot LLM output against Gurobi
Formalize, Don't Optimize: The Heuristic Trap in LLM-Generated Combinatorial Solvers (arXiv:2605.12421), introducing the CP-SynC-XL benchmark across three solver-construction paradigms
reason: Two distinct preprints with different arXiv identifiers (2605.25246 vs 2605.12421), different titles, different benchmarks (FrontierOR vs CP-SynC-XL), different methods and metrics (Gurobi one-shot comparison vs heuristic speedup and paradigm evaluation), and different dates (2026-05-24 vs 2026-05-13); the shared arxiv.org host does not collapse them into one origin.
